title: Diablo IV

custody.physical: Steam digital edition · Blizzard Entertainment build
custody.condition: Account-bound license on the archive Steam account. No physical media is part of this accession.

curatorNotes: Reserved for curator writing on Diablo IV as the archive’s contemporary Diablo series digital filing.
collectionNotes: Ownership is digital only. The retained object is the Steam license. Official cover artwork has been entered from Steam library art; collection photography does not apply.

preservation.playableOn: Windows PC through Steam under archive custody
preservation.compatibility: Continued access requires the archive account, Steam’s support for the title, and Blizzard’s online services where the client requires them.
preservation.concerns: Account-bound digital holdings face platform dependency and policy change. Seasonal live-service structure and online authentication increase preservation risk relative to offline single-player Steam titles. No physical disc or offline installer is held.
preservation.knownRevisions: Steam edition dated October 17, 2023 on the storefront. Seasonal content revises the live client in place; this accession records the licensed digital edition in custody.
preservation.availability: Held as a permanent digital license on the archive Steam account while that custody and the required services for the title continue.

connections.futureReview: Reserved for future critical writing in Bloodsoaked Media.

Catalog identity, authority references, and digital-holding documentation aligned for publication.
